exact_scope: A real-variable proof of the equivalence of the all-epsilon prime-counting error and fractional-part closure in L2(dt/t2).
classical_credit: Theorem3 is the classical Baez-Duarte real integral implication in weighted coordinates; the damped family in Section5 is classical.
important_limit: The actual Mobius H2 moment is infinite, as credited source background; the endpoint sufficient condition is not a viable hypothesis for the actual function.
missing_steps: uniform global H2 bounded subsequence for the explicit damped family
reverse closure-to-prime-error proof by the requested real-variable method
manuscript_status: AI-assisted authored partial-results report; unrefereed; not a claim of a new proof of RH or of the full equivalence.
